description: This file contains test tools and backend logic for WebTransport resets in the quiche QUIC implementation, including classes for handling stream resets, logging, and session management.

classes.name: ResetsVisitor
classes.description: Handles WebTransport session events, manages logs, and creates streams for testing resets.

classes.name: BidirectionalEchoVisitorWithLogging
classes.description: A visitor that echoes data on bidirectional streams with logging of reset and stop sending events.

methods.name: WebTransportResetsBackend
methods.description: Creates a WebTransport response with a ResetsVisitor for handling session resets.

methods.name: OnStopSendingReceived
methods.description: Logs stop sending events for streams.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Adds a log line and triggers sending logs back over streams.

methods.name: MaybeSendLogsBack
methods.description: Sends accumulated logs over new outgoing unidirectional streams if possible.
